name: Elf (2024)
description: Elves have pointed ears and lack facial and body hair. They live for around 750 years, and they don’t sleep but instead enter a trance when they need to rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill (choose one).

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don’t need to sleep, and magic can’t put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

lineages.name: Drow Lineage
lineages.level_1_benefit: The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 feet. You also know the Dancing Lights cantrip.

lineages.name: High Elf Lineage
lineages.level_1_benefit: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

lineages.name: Wood Elf Lineage
lineages.level_1_benefit: Your Speed increases to 35 feet. You also know the Druidcraft cantrip.
